selection_rule: mean of LOD1 polygon vertices lies inside bounds; preserve each selected feature whole
attribution: 東京都・新宿区 3D都市モデル（Project PLATEAU）2025年度を加工して作成
vertical_mode: building local Y = source orthometric height minus common 32.0 m datum; zero-height source road vertices draped to the cropped source TIN with +0.02 m display offset; cameras interpolate the TIN
temporal_limitations: Publication year is not survey year. Feature source_survey_year and source_creation_date are separate. This mixed-epoch modern reference is not a snapshot of the current city or 1976.

survey_year_encoding.note: Tokyo product specification: Gregorian year as four digits; unknown is 0001. Do not interpret 0001 as a known survey year.

road_elevation_limitations: All selected source LOD1 road heights are 0.0 and are treated as missing elevations. Only road vertices are draped to the DEM; triangulated polygon interiors are an approximation, not a terrain-clipped road surface.
